title: Adopt the repo-native delivery lifecycle
outcome: VolleyBro can run the same intake, planning, execution, and verification lifecycle manually or through Symphony.
acceptanceCriteria: WORKFLOW.md defines grill and Wayfinder discussion routing without treating decision tickets as implementation slices.
Manual Apply does not require a Symphony process, claim, dashboard, or workspace manager.
Optional Ingest is separated from ordinary implementation diagnosis and fixes.
